sources.entry: BetterMouse - Customize scrolling, acceleration, buttons, and gestures for third-party mice.

summary.name: BetterMouse
summary.one_liner: A paid macOS utility that customizes third-party mouse and keyboard behavior, including smooth scrolling, cursor acceleration, button and gesture mapping, and per-app settings.
use_cases: Smoothing or reversing scroll direction for a third-party mouse on a Mac
Removing cursor acceleration for precise pointer control
Mapping extra mouse buttons or gestures to keyboard shortcuts
Replacing Logitech Options or G Hub on macOS
Configuring Logi MX Master thumbwheel and DPI settings
Setting different mouse behavior for specific apps
summary.what_it_does: BetterMouse is a macOS menu bar app that provides smooth or discrete scrolling with configurable duration, direction and acceleration. It separates cursor acceleration from speed and can disable acceleration entirely. It maps mouse buttons, drags, holds and hold-scroll to keyboard shortcuts and special actions, and includes per-app exception settings. For supported Logi mice and keyboards, it exposes hardware settings such as DPI, onboard profiles, thumbwheel and backlight, and includes a Unifying/Bolt pairing tool.
notable: Settings for Logi mice and keyboards, including DPI, onboard profiles and thumbwheel
Per-app exception settings for scrolling, buttons and keyboard mapping
Apple-notarized, with no extensions, drivers or agents, and no custom network access per the page
Uninstalls by dragging the app to the Trash
caveats: One-time purchase of $7.99 after a 7-day free trial, with 5 reusable activations per license
Requires macOS 12.0 or later and Apple silicon per the page
Conflicts with other mouse helper apps such as Logi Options+, G Hub and LogiTune, per the troubleshooting section
Left-click-through can interfere with some large apps, requiring per-app exceptions
